'''Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine''' (出雲乃伊波比神社, いづものいわいのかむやしろ, いずものいわいじんじゃ) refers to the name of a Shinto shrine.

* '''Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine''' - A small shrine listed under the ''Engishiki'' in {{ill|Musashi Province|en|Musashi Province|qid=Q907398|lt=Musashi Province}} {{ill|Obusuma district|ja|男衾郡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Obusuma District|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11578175}}. There are two candidate shrines.
* {{ill|Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Yorii Town)|ja|出雲乃伊波比神社 (寄居町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Yorii Town)}} - Located in {{ill|Yorii, Saitama|en|Yorii, Saitama|qid=Q961604|lt=Yorii Town}}, {{ill|Ōsato District, Saitama|en|Ōsato District, Saitama|qid=Q1075196|lt=Ōsato District}}, {{ill|Saitama Prefecture|en|Saitama Prefecture|qid=Q128186|lt=Saitama Prefecture}} (formerly Obusuma District). One of the candidate shrines.
* {{ill|Izumo-no-Iwai Shrine (Kumagaya City)|ja|出雲乃伊波比神社 (熊谷市)}} - Located in {{ill|Kumagaya|ar|كوماغايا (سايتاما)|azb|کوماقایا، سایتاما|be|Кумагая|bg|Кумагая|ce|Кумагая|ceb|Kumagaya|cs|Kumagaja|de|Kumagaya|eo|Kumagaja|es|Kumagaya|fa|کوماگایا، سایتاما|fi|Kumagaya|fr|Kumagaya|ga|Kumagaya|gl|Kumagaya|id|Kumagaya, Saitama|it|Kumagaya|ja|熊谷市|ko|구마가야시|lt|Kumagaja|mg|Kumagaya|mn|Күмагая|mzn|کوماگایا، سایتاما|nl|Kumagaya|no|Kumagaya|pl|Kumagaya|pt|Kumagaya|ro|Kumagaya|ru|Кумагая|sh|Kumagaja|simple|Kumagaya|sr|Кумагаја|sv|Kumagaya|tg|Кумагая|th|คูมางายะ|tl|Kumagaya|tr|Kumagaya|tt|Кумагая|tum|Kumagaya|uk|Кумаґая|ur|کوماگایا، سائیتاما|vi|Kumagaya|war|Kumagaya, Saitama|zh|熊谷市|zh_classical|熊谷市|zh_min_nan|Kumagaya-chhī|zh_yue|熊谷|qid=Q41106|lt=Kumagaya City}}, Saitama Prefecture (formerly Obusuma District).
